name: ai-player-mobile
subtitle: Mobile AI co-pilot: miners, defenders and compact HUD
author: donatodiaz
description:
Mobile version of AI Player for Mindustry v8.

[accent]Features:[]
- Fair AI miners and defenders with real resource costs.
- Dynamic support for Exogenesis and New Horizon units and ores.
- Compact collapsible HUD on the right side.
- No local LLM: Android devices do not need to run Ollama.
- Works without Java mods; uses Mindustry scripts.

Use the small AI button on the right side to expand the panel and toggle the AI.
